items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: I like to wake him with John Joseph, that's a good man too. I worked with him, I worked with his brother for years.

ctx.x: John Porter. It's that old man you had last night there. I like to wake him with John Joseph, that's a good man too. I worked with him, I worked with his brother for years. His brother got killed, come to California and got killed. I'm going to be able to kill him.
